evals.prompt: I want to create a remotion project for a product promo video with 3D animations. Set up everything I need to get started.
evals.expected_output: A scaffolded Remotion project with all effects packages installed, example compositions including a 3D ThreeCanvas scene, and the studio server running.
expectations: Output includes a Root.tsx file that registers compositions using <Composition>
Output includes a 3D scene component that imports ThreeCanvas from @remotion/three
Output references at least @remotion/three, three, and @types/three in the package list
At least 4 example compositions are registered in Root.tsx
Output includes a comprehensive list of npm packages to install (at least 10 @remotion/* packages)

evals.prompt: Set up a new video animation project. I need smooth transitions between scenes and some organic particle effects for the background.
evals.expected_output: A Remotion project with transitions demo (fade/slide/wipe) and noise-driven particle composition, all packages installed, studio running.
expectations: Output includes a transitions component that uses TransitionSeries from @remotion/transitions
Output demonstrates at least 2 different transition presentations (fade, slide, wipe, flip, or clockWipe)
Output includes a particle/noise component that uses noise2D from @remotion/noise
Output uses shape components or generators from @remotion/shapes

evals.prompt: I need to build an animated explainer video using React, with motion graphics and text animations that have a cinematic feel. Can you scaffold a project for me?
evals.expected_output: A Remotion project with motion blur text animation, spring physics, all effects packages, and a guide file explaining how to use each package.
expectations: Output includes a component using CameraMotionBlur from @remotion/motion-blur
Output uses spring() function for physics-based animation
Output includes text animation with transform and/or opacity changes
A guide or reference file is produced explaining key packages and their usage
